_doc: Tiers for the AI per-game config. allow = the AI may change it; risky = only with a curated precedent, shown as experimental; preference = the player's taste, the AI never changes it; never = the AI never changes it. Keys missing here are never. See README.md.

never_reasons.bc_decode: chosen from the GPU's BCn support; forcing it only tests the Mali path
never_reasons.output_res: experiment to find a resolution value; wrong values break the game's output
never_reasons.gfx7_mimg_dim: bisection aid; on is the PS4 fix
never_reasons.gfx7_htile: bisection aid; on is the PS4 fix
never_reasons.gfx7_htile_gen: bisection aid; on is the PS4 fix
never_reasons.gfx7_fast_clear: bisection aid; on is the PS4 fix
never_reasons.srt_flat: A/B of an internal fast path
never_reasons.descriptor_stream: A/B against the old shared ring
never_reasons.bda_batch: A/B against the old per-buffer barriers
never_reasons.quirk_kill_exports_depth: driver quirk, detected from the driver

descriptions.res_scale: Internal resolution per axis, in thousandths (500 = half width and height, a quarter of the pixels). Lower relieves the GPU; a few games draw wrong at lower scales. Unreal Engine games default to 25 % unless the game has its own value.
descriptions.async_pipelines: Compile shaders in the background. Avoids stutter; an object may take a moment to appear. Off compiles every pipeline before drawing.
descriptions.shadow_scale: Shadow map size in thousandths, independent of the internal resolution. Lower is faster; shadows get softer or blockier. No effect on engines that draw shadows with compute (Unreal Engine 5).
descriptions.no_early_z: Inverted switch: 1 (default) never forces early depth tests; 0 lets the GPU skip hidden pixels before shading. 0 is faster with heavy overdraw; on some Adreno drivers objects vanish in small blocks.
descriptions.suspend_early: Release GPU suspend points once every earlier packet is submitted, without waiting for the host GPU, so the game's CPU can run up to a frame ahead. Fewer CPU waits; late texture downloads could land in reused memory. Unmeasured, off by default.
descriptions.draw_window_reuse: Reuse the copy of a CPU-written buffer made earlier in the same draw window instead of copying it again. Less copying in buffer-heavy games; reusing too widely broke geometry in Asterix XXL2.
descriptions.resolve_cache: Skip texture and render-target resolves whose source and registers did not change (PS5 games only). Less GPU work in games that repeat the same resolves.
descriptions.image_readback: Download GPU-written images before the CPU reads their memory. Fixes effects the CPU computes from GPU output (black indirect lighting in Unreal Engine 4); costs GPU waits.
descriptions.htile_clear_exact: Treat only a write of exactly the live HTile range as a depth metadata clear. Default PS5 games; Off is the old rule (can hang the GPU or leave buffers unfilled); PS4 sizes are estimated.
descriptions.movrel_prune: Fold register-index comparisons in shaders (constant propagation). Off keeps the comparisons, for shaders that compute wrong after folding.
descriptions.guarded_desc: Track descriptors of writable shaders without a GPU phi. Off restores the phi for every descriptor (older, slower, for shaders that bind the wrong resource).
descriptions.color_compare: Emulate depth-compare sampling of color textures with gather and sample. Off keeps the undefined native compare (older behaviour).
descriptions.depth_color_direct_copy: Copy between depth and matching color images directly (Vulkan maintenance8) instead of through a buffer. Off always uses the buffer path.
descriptions.in_pass_stream: Inside a render pass, serve CPU-modified read-only buffers from the stream ring instead of ending the pass to sync them. Avoids lost depth writes on Adreno (Dead Cells walls).
descriptions.pass_fresh_reuse: Reuse a render pass's fresh buffer copy for later draws of the pass. Fewer copies; wrong when data changes between draws (vanishing buildings in Asterix XXL2).
descriptions.sample_in_general: Sample images in the GENERAL layout. Wrong mips on the stock Adreno driver (blurry, blocky textures); Turnip was fine.
descriptions.no_barycentric: Do not use the driver's fragment barycentrics; use the fallback. For Turnip builds on Adreno 8xx whose compiler fails on them.
descriptions.output_4k: Report a 4K display to the game instead of 1080p. Games that size rendering from the output then render about four times the pixels; only for games that need a 4K output.
descriptions.depth_kick: Adreno fix: clear one depth pixel before a pass that starts with a depth-writing ALWAYS draw, which otherwise loses its depth writes (fog-coloured trails).
descriptions.ds_feedback_merge: Use the feedback-loop layout when draws alternate between sampling and writing depth/stencil, instead of ending the pass at every draw. Off splits the pass (slower).
descriptions.keep_ds_layout: Keep a depth image's current attachment layout when the draw's writes allow it, avoiding layout changes that end the pass.
descriptions.merge_access: Merge attachment and shader-read access inside a render pass instead of emitting barriers that end it. Off emits the barriers (slower).
descriptions.async_readback: Let CPU reads proceed while GPU-written pages download, when they are clear of GPU-written bytes. Off makes every access to those pages wait for the GPU.
descriptions.batch_submits: Keep recording queued graphics batches into one command buffer. Off flushes after every batch (Unity games then reload render targets often).
descriptions.fence_tracking: Track GPU progress with one fence per submission on its own thread instead of timeline semaphores. Helps Turnip on KGSL, where timelines cost about 3 ms per submission.
descriptions.unmap_finish: Wait for the whole GPU before memory the GPU used is unmapped. Off (default) waits only for GPU-written data; on is the older, slow behaviour (Monster Boy at 14 FPS).
descriptions.eop_flush: Submit the queue after every release label, not only those that raise an interrupt. Costs a blocking submit per Unreal Engine 4 fence on Adreno.
descriptions.defer_release_barrier: Defer the global barrier of release labels inside a render pass instead of ending the pass. Off ends the pass (UE4 split its depth passes per occlusion query).
descriptions.cpu_fill: Run plain buffer fills (Unreal Engine 4 color metadata keys) on the CPU. Off runs them on the GPU, and later CPU reads wait for it.
descriptions.gpu_indirect: Read indirect draw arguments on the GPU. Off reads them on the CPU.
descriptions.gpu_fast_cores: Pin the emulator's GPU thread to the cores with the highest maximum clock. Off leaves it to the scheduler.
descriptions.poll_backoff: Back off after failed event-flag polls. Off lets those polls spin (more CPU).
descriptions.yield_us: Microseconds to sleep after a burst of guest yields (Unreal polls with millions). 0 keeps sched_yield; a short sleep can free the core and power budget.
descriptions.ngs2_custom_output_fallback: NGS2 audio: a custom mastering voice without an Output module writes its first buffer (default). Off leaves it silent.
descriptions.ngs2_filters: NGS2 audio: apply the sampler filters. Off ignores them, as the old layout mostly did.
descriptions.ngs2_limiter: NGS2 audio: apply the mastering limiter. Off leaves the output unlimited, as before the limiter.
descriptions.ngs2_repeats_extra: NGS2 audio: play 1 + num_repeats passes of a block, as before the fix (default plays max(1, num_repeats)).
descriptions.ngs2_voice_index_fallback: NGS2 audio: hand out the last voice for an out-of-range voice index instead of returning an error, as before the fix.
descriptions.ngs2_at9_delay: NGS2 audio: count the ATRAC9 decoder delay. Off parses ATRAC9 blocks as before the fix (no delay, fact chunk's delay and skip).
descriptions.audio2_push_unreserved: AudioOut2: commit a grain on a push without a reservation, as before the fix, for games that push without advancing.
descriptions.tso: Emulate x86 TSO memory ordering for guest loads and stores (on by default). Turning it off makes CPU emulation faster but breaks lock-free code: Unreal Engine games crash in their task graph. Only suggest off for a non-Unreal game that is CPU-bound and known to be stable without it.
descriptions.direct_mem_mb: Size of the guest's direct memory in MiB (PS5 has 13824). Read once at start.
descriptions.clip_reserve: Shrink the huge fixed memory reservations of Unreal Engine 4/5 to fit a 39-bit host address space. Off makes those games fail to start.
descriptions.address_fold: Fold guest addresses beyond a 39-bit host address space. Off breaks games that map memory there.
descriptions.guest_native: Run some HLE functions as guest code instead of traps. Off keeps every HLE function a trap (slower).
descriptions.fex_host_features: Detect the host CPU's features for the x86 translator. Off uses a fixed list.
descriptions.guest_read_cache: Cache small guest memory reads per thread.
descriptions.stream_mb: Size of the per-draw stream ring in MiB (read at start). Larger can reduce GPU waits; 128+ broke geometry in Asterix XXL2.
descriptions.read_ahead_kb: KiB of GPU-written buffer to download after a faulting CPU read (0 = only the faulting pages).
descriptions.write_fault_kb: KiB window released around a CPU write fault on a buffer (4 = one page, power of two).
descriptions.event_barriers: Global barriers on partial flush events. Off is experimental (KytyPS5 dropped them).
descriptions.defer_write_barrier: Barrier after draws whose shaders write memory: 2 defers and tracks written ranges (default), 1 defers blindly (flicker in Stray), 0 ends the pass after each such draw.
descriptions.rp_mode: Render pass clears on Adreno: 3 opens with LOAD and clears inside (default), 0 loadOp CLEAR, 1 keeps the pass when only clears change, 2 clears in a pass of its own.
descriptions.pix_center: Half-pixel shift for D3D9-style pixel centers: 0 follows the game's register, 1 never shifts, 2 always shifts.
descriptions.kill_mode: How shaders discard pixels: 0 OpKill, 1 OpTerminateInvocation, 2 OpDemoteToHelperInvocation.
descriptions.fp_preserve: Declare signed zero, infinity and NaN preservation in shaders. Off lets the driver use fast math.
descriptions.exact_denorm: Flush F32 denormal shader inputs as RDNA does. Costs a compare and select per operand.
descriptions.exact_minmax: Exact NaN and signed-zero handling of shader min/max.
descriptions.loop_budget: Loop iterations a compute dispatch may spend in all, before loops are cut to stay under the driver's timeout.
descriptions.loop_cap: Loop iterations per shader invocation of small dispatches and graphics stages before the loop is cut.
descriptions.wait_us: Microseconds the GPU thread waits for a label before logging and moving on.
descriptions.ts_scale: GPU timestamps advance N times faster, so games that size rendering from GPU time see a slower GPU.
descriptions.scaled_dispatch: Downscale full-screen compute grids with the resolution scale. Experimental; no tested game qualified.
descriptions.prefetch: Prefetch pipelines for queued graphics submissions.
descriptions.audio2_openal: Render AudioOut2 objects through OpenAL Soft (3D audio objects).
